items.title: Deshaun Watson: Inaccurate in Week 5 loss
items.text:
Watson completed 15 of 33 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown while rushing six times for 40 yards in Sunday's 17-12 loss to the Jets. He also lost a fumble.

items.title: Cam Ward: Little success in Week 5 rout
